data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for sharing contents, text, and URLs to various social media platforms.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to share text, URLs, and local images/files to social networks like Facebook, WhatsApp, Twitter, Instagram, Telegram, as well as SMS, email, and system share dialogs.
use_when: You need direct integrations to share content to specific apps like WhatsApp, Facebook, or Twitter.
You want to share local media files (images) or text directly to social platforms.
avoid_when: You only need a generic system share dialog (where `share_plus` might be simpler).
You want a zero-setup solution without platform-specific configurations like URL schemes.
strengths: Supports multiple social channels including WhatsApp Business and Telegram.
Provides methods for specific platform payloads like image paths and mail bodies.
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration of AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist queries/schemes for each platform.
Some APIs and platform apps are not universally supported (e.g., WhatsApp Business on iOS throws unimplemented error).
data.setup_notes: Requires platform-specific setup including adding queries/schemes for apps like WhatsApp, Facebook, Twitter, and SMS in AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist.

alternatives.name: share_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is a widely used and actively maintained community standard for system-level sharing.
